fact: As of 27 May 2025 36 entities were enrolled on the home-grown e-GP piloted in 5 PDEs and rolled out in 2021, with rollout of the enhanced e-GP to all procuring entities planned to start in FY 2025/2026, integrated with IFMS, e-tax, National ID and business registration.
title: Taking Stock of the Impact of MAPS in Africa, including the e-GP System: The Case of Uganda
publisher: Ministry of Finance, Planning and Economic Development (presentation to APPN)
